tasks.short: Check compliance and complete service reports.

steps.what: Read the applicable equipment instructions, safety regulations and building-code requirements for this installation
Perform safety checks and determine actual conformance, retaining physical tests and technical judgement
Complete and check the service report in the maintenance system {OPS_SYSTEM}, entering actual results and exceptions with native equipment headers
Save the checked service report in {OPS_SYSTEM}
Release the checked report to the designated building operator through {OPS_SYSTEM}

tasks.design: Configure native service-report fields in {OPS_SYSTEM} to reuse equipment identity and report headings. The technician performs every actual check, writes findings and checks the finished report and recipient before separate save and release actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated equipment headers consume report-writing time.
tasks.enabler_now: A native maintenance form can reuse the equipment master without deciding compliance.
tasks.still_hard: Determining whether the installed equipment actually meets the applicable requirements.
tasks.human_edge: Physical inspection and accountable technical judgement.

ambition.what: No extra inspections or automatic certification is promised.

tasks.altitude: Less report repetition; unchanged safety responsibility.

evidence.claim: Native maintenance forms can reuse equipment metadata while actual test findings and conformance decisions remain human.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual compliance checks and the conformance report, its save and routine release. General repair-log maintenance belongs to 11573 and is not credited here.

Maintenance administration supplies equipment ID, site, model, serial number and form revision; the technician produces actual result, test date, exception and conclusion in s3. Missing metadata is entered manually; no planned check becomes a passed test.
Try native fields first. Savings apply only to reusable headings, not observation, interpretation or narrative findings. Shares are provisional work estimates, not measured baselines.
The normal author check in s3 covers the exact finished report, recipient and release purpose; any edit voids both references. No extra self-approval ceremony is added.
unknowns: Existing form configuration and actual header-entry time.
research_questions: Does equipment reuse reduce report entry while preserving exceptions?

already_counted.description: Actual requirements reading, physical checks and conformance judgement remain fully counted.

incremental.description: Maintain report fields and equipment mappings.

approvals.approved_version: Final report content checked in s3; edits require recheck.
Exact final report and building-operator recipient checked in s3; edits require recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: At 25% less time on the 23-share report step, gross is 5.75 points less 0.75 upkeep. Low is native reuse already present; no check or send saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interpret blueprints and select installation equipment.

steps.what: Read the current blueprints and specifications for elevator components, frameworks and foundations
Interpret dimensions, interfaces, framework and foundation layout against the actual installation constraints
Select appropriate installation equipment from loads, access and the interpreted layout

tasks.design: Retain native drawing viewing in {DOCS} and the technician's interpretation and equipment choice. A drawing-summary model does not remove the need to read dimensions, interfaces and equipment constraints.
tasks.previous_blocker: Interpretation depends on site constraints and technical meaning rather than repeated record entry.
tasks.enabler_now: No additional tool is justified by the supplied evidence for this boundary.
tasks.still_hard: Recognizing incompatible clearances and choosing safe installation equipment.

ambition.what: No automated installation planning is promised.

reach.learn: Drawing revisions and lift planning interfaces.

evidence.claim: Drawing viewers support reading, but interpreting elevator installation interfaces and equipment suitability still requires technical judgement.

assumptions: Boundary is reading, interpreting and selecting equipment, not purchasing or issuing an installation order. The statement has no separate report or send; ordinary drawing reading is explicit in s1 and no extra administration is invented.
Drawing control supplies document ID, revision, dimensions and equipment specifications. Missing or conflicting dimensions require human clarification, not inferred values.
Native viewing is the baseline. Runtime and already available navigation are not labour savings. Zero ongoing upkeep follows from no system change.
unknowns: Actual drawing quality and site variation.
research_questions: Is any repeated dimension transfer actually present before proposing a calculator?

already_counted.description: Full drawing reading, interpretation and equipment choice.

incremental.description: No system change or ongoing upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All reading and technical choices remain; no repeated calculation, report or send baseline has been established.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain repair and check log books.

steps.what: Capture actual repairs, parts, readings and checks performed, including unresolved faults
Enter and check the log-book entry in {OPS_SYSTEM}, reusing equipment and job identity while preserving actual detail
Save the checked entry to the equipment log book in {OPS_SYSTEM}

tasks.design: Configure the native equipment log in {OPS_SYSTEM} to reuse job identity and equipment headers. The technician captures actual work and checks the finished entry before saving; no scheduled repair is treated as completed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Log entries can repeat equipment and work-order identity.
tasks.enabler_now: Native equipment-linked forms can reuse identifiers and required headings.
tasks.still_hard: Recording the actual intervention and unresolved conditions accurately.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing what was physically done and what remains unsafe or uncertain.

ambition.what: No additional maintenance service is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less repetitive log entry; unchanged repair responsibility.

evidence.claim: Equipment-linked maintenance records can reuse identifiers while technicians still capture and verify actual repair details.

assumptions: Boundary starts after physical repair or testing and includes the entire log entry. Physical work is not credited. The separate conformance service report in 11567 is not regenerated or credited here.

Dispatch supplies job ID and equipment administration supplies asset ID, site and model. The technician supplies actual date, work, parts, readings, test outcome and unresolved fault in s1, whose full time remains. Missing codes and offline observations use manual entry in the same counted work.

Test native fields first. No speech model, status inference or new capture burden is assumed. Savings concern repeated identity and headings in s2; its substantive detail and normal author check remain.
The normal check in s2 binds the finished entry; no new self-approval step is added. Ordinary save retains 1% and full effort.
unknowns: How much repeated header entry exists in the current log.
research_questions: Can native linked entries remove repeated identity while retaining exceptions?

already_counted.description: Actual work capture remains fully counted.

incremental.description: Maintain log field mappings and required headings.

approvals.approved_version: Final log entry checked in s2; any edit requires recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 35% less time in the 44-share entry step saves 15.4 points less 1 upkeep. Low is linked fields already present; actual capture and save have no saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the training materials and updated equipment instructions
Participate in instructor-led demonstrations, practical exercises and assessment
Check actual attendance evidence and the completion detail presented in {LMS}
Save the checked personal completion acknowledgement in {LMS}

tasks.design: Keep practical training and study with the technician using existing {LMS} materials. The small post-training acknowledgement is explicit and retains its full time; no additional training administration or model summary is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Competence depends on learning and practice rather than repeated administration.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing training systems already support materials and acknowledgement.
tasks.still_hard: Demonstrating correct procedures on actual equipment.
tasks.human_edge: Hands-on learning and asking an instructor about uncertainties.

ambition.what: No new training service is assumed.

evidence.claim: Training systems can hold materials and completion records, but practical participation remains human work.

assumptions: Boundary is participation in already assigned training, including any routine personal completion acknowledgement. Course procurement and scheduling are not invented as large baselines.

The training coordinator supplies course ID, version and assigned learner; the instructor supplies actual attendance and assessment evidence after s2. Missing evidence is checked manually in s3, never inferred from an invitation.
The 2% completion tail is provisional and fully retained; where acknowledgement is unnecessary there is no tail or saving. The existing native system is unchanged, so incremental upkeep is zero.
The ordinary check in s3 binds the exact acknowledgement; edits void it. No new self-approval ceremony is introduced.
unknowns: Whether a personal acknowledgement is required for the actual course.
research_questions: Does the existing training record already capture completion without technician re-entry?

already_counted.description: Study, practical participation and assessment remain counted.

incremental.description: No new system or ongoing upkeep.

approvals.approved_version: Exact completion acknowledgement checked in s3 after actual training; edits require recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Full study and practical learning remain. The explicit completion check and ordinary save also remain, so no saving is claimed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use equipment-linked records while retaining hands-on installation and safety judgement.
reach: Help maintenance planners improve asset identifiers and repair-history fields.
role.ambitious_version: A technician with clearer equipment histories and unchanged technical accountability.
